english.title: Owner/master of ship fail to ensure compliance with reg 26 Chapter V Safety of Life at Sea

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Merchant Shipping Safety of Navigation regulations 2002
International Convention for Safety of life at sea 1974

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[the master]_
(B)_[the owner]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with paragraph 3.1 of regulation 26 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 relating to failure to display steering gear changeover procedures on navigational bridge in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE...)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(k) and 11(1)(c) and (2) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.

Summary: A fine.
